system: Bosniak Classification of Cystic Renal Masses, Version 2019

inputs.label: Infectious, inflammatory or vascular lesion, or necrotic solid mass
inputs.how_stated: true when the finding is called an abscess, an infected or inflamed collection, a vascular lesion or a necrotic solid mass rather than a cystic renal mass; false when it is described as a renal cyst or cystic renal mass

locator.section: Proposed Update to the Bosniak Classification of Cystic Renal Masses

inputs.label: Too small to characterise
inputs.how_stated: yes when dictated as 'too small to characterise' (eg, section thickness over half the diameter), and then whether it is well-defined, homogeneous and of low attenuation; no when the mass is described by its features (wall, septa, contents or attenuation) rather than called too small

locator.section: Proposed Update to the Bosniak Classification of Cystic Renal Masses

inputs.label: CT technique
inputs.how_stated: renal mass protocol CT (unenhanced plus contrast phases); unenhanced CT only; a single portal venous phase only; or other contrast-enhanced CT with no unenhanced series

locator.section: Proposed Update to the Bosniak Classification of Cystic Renal Masses
Proposed Update to the Bosniak Classification of Cystic Renal Masses

inputs.label: Wall
inputs.how_stated: smooth wall thin (2 mm or less, may enhance), minimally thickened (3 mm) or thick (4 mm or more), and whether that wall enhances; not enhancing, or enhancement not assessable (needs unenhanced and enhanced images to compare, or a measurement)

locator.section: General Points

inputs.label: Septa (the one that sets the highest class)
inputs.how_stated: no septa; few (1 to 3) thin (2 mm or less) septa, enhancing or not; many (4 or more) thin septa; or a minimally thickened (3 mm) or thick (4 mm or more) septum, and whether it enhances. Give the highest-class enhancing septum; if none enhances, the thickest. not enhancing, or enhancement not assessable (needs unenhanced and enhanced images to compare, or a measurement)

locator.section: General Points

inputs.label: Convex protrusion from wall or septa (most significant)
inputs.how_stated: none (smooth); irregular thickening (enhancing, obtuse margins, 3 mm or less); nodule (enhancing, acute margins of any size, or obtuse margins and 4 mm or more); or a protrusion that does not enhance or cannot be assessed. Measure perpendicular to its wall or septum, adding protrusions on both sides and excluding the septum. Code the most suspicious protrusion: an enhancing one over a non-enhancing one, and a nodule over irregular thickening.

locator.section: General Points

inputs.label: Calcification
inputs.how_stated: calcification of any type, or none

locator.section: Proposed Update to the Bosniak Classification of Cystic Renal Masses

inputs.label: Contents
inputs.how_stated: fluid of uniform attenuation throughout, or heterogeneous contents

locator.section: General Points

inputs.label: Mass contents enhancement (not wall or septa)
inputs.how_stated: whether the mass contents themselves enhance (not the wall or septa, which are coded on their own inputs), comparing unenhanced and enhanced series; absent means a non-enhancing mass

locator.section: Proposed Update to the Bosniak Classification of Cystic Renal Masses

inputs.label: Attenuation of contents
inputs.how_stated: attenuation in HU on the unenhanced series (on the contrast-enhanced series if there is no unenhanced one)

outcomes.classification: Bosniak I (v2019): benign simple renal cyst.
caveats: Not for patients with a renal cell carcinoma syndrome; patient factors still shape management.

locator.section: General Points

outcomes.classification: Bosniak II (v2019): benign or likely benign cystic renal mass.
caveats: Call it a cyst only if confirmed as one; otherwise a likely benign mass.

Abundant thick or nodular calcification, heterogeneous contents (including non-enhancing septa 3 mm or thicker), or a homogeneous hyperattenuating non-enhancing mass over 3 cm may be better assessed by MRI first.
Not for patients with a renal cell carcinoma syndrome; patient factors still shape management.

locator.section: General Points

outcomes.classification: Bosniak IIF (v2019) cystic renal mass: most are benign, and malignant ones are nearly all indolent.
outcomes.recommendation: Imaging follow-up at 6 and 12 months, then yearly to 5 years in total, looking for morphological change.
caveats: Not for patients with a renal cell carcinoma syndrome; patient factors still shape management.

locator.section: General Points

outcomes.classification: Bosniak III (v2019) cystic renal mass: intermediate probability of malignancy (about half).
outcomes.recommendation: Consider urology referral if not already arranged.
caveats: Whether observation or treatment suits class III best is unclear in the source.
Not for patients with a renal cell carcinoma syndrome; patient factors still shape management.

locator.section: General Points

outcomes.classification: Bosniak IV (v2019) cystic renal mass: most are malignant (about 90%).
outcomes.recommendation: Consider urology referral if not already arranged.
caveats: Not for patients with a renal cell carcinoma syndrome; patient factors still shape management.

locator.section: General Points

outcomes.classification: Features do not fit a Bosniak 2019 class; manage on its features.
outcomes.recommendation: Consider dedicated renal mass protocol CT or MRI (with subtraction) to look for enhancing elements before assigning a class.
caveats: The source allows a rare undefined combination to be placed in IIF.
Enhancement needs unenhanced and enhanced images to compare, or a measurement; a cystic mass is under about 25% enhancing tissue.

outcomes.classification: Enhancing contents on renal mass protocol CT: not a cystic renal mass, so outside the Bosniak classification.
outcomes.recommendation: Manage as a solid renal mass.
caveats: Bosniak 2019 treats a mass with about 25% or more enhancing tissue as solid, whatever its cystic pattern.

outcomes.classification: Bosniak 2019 does not apply: an infectious, inflammatory or vascular lesion, or a necrotic solid mass, is outside the classification

summary.text: Bosniak v2019 grades the likelihood of malignancy in a cystic renal mass (I, II, IIF, III, IV) from CT or MRI features.

locator.section: Abstract

summary.text: IV: enhancing nodule. III: enhancing thick (4 mm or more) or irregular wall or septa. IIF: minimally thickened (3 mm) enhancing wall or septa, or 4 or more thin enhancing septa.

summary.text: I and II are well-defined with thin smooth walls; II covers few thin septa, calcification, and several homogeneous attenuation types.

summary.text: When features span classes, assign the highest class.

definitions.text: Cystic mass: less than about 25% of the mass is enhancing tissue.

locator.section: General Points

definitions.text: Enhancement: clear visible enhancement comparing unenhanced and enhanced images, or measurable by established thresholds.

locator.section: General Points

definitions.text: Homogeneous: similar attenuation throughout; a thin wall is allowed but no septa or calcification.

locator.section: General Points

definitions.text: Simple fluid at CT: homogeneous, -9 to 20 HU on unenhanced or enhanced CT.

locator.section: General Points

definitions.text: Septum: a linear or curvilinear structure joining two surfaces. Few: 1 to 3. Many: 4 or more.

locator.section: General Points

definitions.text: Wall or septum: thin 2 mm or less; minimally thickened 3 mm; thick 4 mm or more. Guideposts, not absolutes.

locator.section: General Points

definitions.text: Irregular thickening: focal or diffuse enhancing convex protrusion(s) 3 mm or less with obtuse margins.

locator.section: General Points

definitions.text: Nodule: enhancing convex protrusion of any size with acute margins, or 4 mm or more with obtuse margins.

locator.section: General Points

definitions.text: Measure protrusions perpendicular to the wall or septum; if on both sides, add them, excluding the wall itself.

locator.section: General Points

definitions.text: Too small to characterise: eg, section thickness over half the mass diameter; small masses near enhancing parenchyma also suffer pseudoenhancement.

pitfalls.text: Reporting phrases are for the general population, not renal cell carcinoma syndromes.

locator.section: General Points

pitfalls.text: Say 'cyst' only for class I and confirmed class II cysts; avoid 'complex' or 'complicated cyst'.

locator.section: General Points

pitfalls.text: Size and growth are not part of the classification; in surveillance, morphological change matters most.

pitfalls.text: It predicts the likelihood of cancer, not its behaviour; it is not a full management algorithm.
